data.desc: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Limited is an international owner and operator of dry bulk vessels. As of November 10, 2026, Costamare Bulkers' owned dry bulk fleet consisted of 29 vessels with a total carrying capacity of approximately 2.6 million DWT. Costamare Bulkers also owns a dry bulk operating platform, CBI, which charters in and charters out dry bulk vessels, enters into contracts of affreightment and forward freight agreements and may utilize other hedging solutions.
